title: Search Overlay
purpose: Project-wide file search with live results and preview pane
states: open-empty - search open with no query
focused-result - specific result selected for preview
acceptance: shall expand search field in cluster bar when opened
shall display results covering split row and below
shall show match count and file tree organization
shall display selected result in preview pane (Monaco)
shall highlight search matches in preview
shall navigate results with arrow keys
shall open result in Files app on double-click or Enter
shall keep field visible and focused while overlay is open
